Checkout Service

The checkout service turns a cart into a paid order.
It owns pricing, tax & payment orchestration.

1. Overview

Requests arrive through the API gateway and are processed in three stages.

    2. Request flow

    sequenceDiagram
  Gateway->>Checkout: POST /orders
  Checkout->>Payments: authorize(amount)
  Payments-->>Checkout: approved

    3. Pricing rules

    RuleApplies toPriority
    volume_discountcarts over 10 items2
    couponany cart with a valid code1
    loyaltymembers only3

    4. API

    Create an order with POST /orders; the response carries the order id.

    Emits order.created and order.paid on the event bus.

    Error codes

    Payment failures return 402; stale carts return 409.
